desc: Preprocess conflictingPairs: normalize each pair so that a = min, b = max. Store original index.
Create an array of lists `pairs_by_max` where `pairs_by_max[b]` contains list of (a, original_index) for pairs with max element b.
Sweep r from 1 to n, maintaining the best and second best (min_val, index) pairs seen so far (i.e., with max element <= r). For each r, record:
base_L[r]: the min_val of the best pair
base_idx[r]: the original index of the best pair
fallback_L[r]: the min_val of the second best pair (0 if none)
Initialize an array S of zeros of length m (number of conflicting pairs).
For r from 1 to n, if base_idx[r] is valid, add (base_L[r] - fallback_L[r]) to S[base_idx[r]].
For each pair index i from 0 to m-1, compute result_i = total_base + S[i].
